title: AIRoute configuration
description: Configuration for the AIRoute local gateway.

registry.description: Ordered list of source plugins. Order matters later for alias candidate ranking.

items.description: Entries may carry extra per-source options; unknown-but-disabled types are tolerated with a warning.

type.description: Source plugin type. Extend this enum as new source packages land.

cacheTtlMs.description: Freshness window (ms) for cached per-source model catalogs; 0 disables caching.

rank.description: Weights used by alias candidate ranking (Phase 2).

aliases.description: Gateway-level model aliases, e.g. "free-best": ["zai/glm-4.5-flash", "openrouter/model-id"]; the first enabled candidate wins (ranking arrives in Phase 2).

monitor.description: Health monitoring (Phase 2): per-source probe cadence, metrics and circuit-breaker tuning. Omitted fields fall back to their defaults and the whole section may be omitted.

enabled.description: Master switch for the monitor (probe scheduling).

probeEveryMs.description: Base probe cadence per source (15 min default).

jitterMs.description: Max random jitter added to every probe cadence (1 min default).

requestFailureWindowMs.description: Rolling window (ms) for counting request failures toward a degrade (10 min default).

cooldownMs.description: Base cooldown (ms) for 429/capacity failures; doubles on consecutive failures, capped at 30 min.
